utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — when’s the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Next Thursday evening, if that still works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Next Thursday works for me.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to join, but I’d want to know the time and where it’s being held so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure — I’ll confirm the time and place before you commit.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — I’m happy to wait until you confirm those details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the book club. What were we reading this week again?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I keep mixing it up—was it the mystery one, or the one about the lighthouse? If you remind me the title, I’ll catch up fast.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m blanking too, honestly. Let’s check the group message and figure it out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll bring it up at book club and see what everyone thinks.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—let me know what they say at book club.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ll ask them at book club and tell you what they think.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late — what book are we discussing?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — we’re talking about "The Midnight Library" tonight. I’ve got a spare copy if you want to borrow it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’d be great, thanks. I’ll borrow it and catch up before next time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me, Quinn—what’s the plan for the book club this week?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great! I’ll send everyone the details and invite people over for Thursday evening at my place—let’s keep it cozy and easy.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect—Thursday evening at your place sounds nice and simple. Just send me the details, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, are we still on for book club this week?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, still on for this week — I’m looking forward to it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time and place are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hi Opal — I’m thinking the book club should keep things cozy this week. Want me to bring a few snack options and a discussion question?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds lovely, Jules — snacks and a good question would be perfect. I’ll keep track of where we meet and make sure everyone knows the plan.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thank you, Opal — I’ll bring a couple easy snacks and a question that gets everyone talking.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with book club however I can—what are you thinking for our next read?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I was thinking we could pick something upbeat and discussion-friendly—maybe a novel with a few strong themes but not too heavy. Want to toss out a couple of favorites and see what everyone might enjoy?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—how about something warm and witty like "The Guernsey Literary and Potato Peel Pie Society" or "A Man Called Ove"? Both have plenty to talk about without feeling too heavy.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve still got some tea and snacks left if the book club wants them. What book are we discussing tonight?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, thanks — that’d be great. I think we’re doing the mystery one tonight, but I should double-check.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — just let me know if you want me to bring the tea and snacks over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club? I heard they’re picking something a little lighter this month, which honestly sounds nice.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That does sound nice. I might actually join this time if it’s a lighter read.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You should! I’ll swing by if you want, and we can compare notes after the first meeting.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — what time and place is the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Let’s meet at the school library at 3:30 after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — school library at 3:30 after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the book and time, and I’ll see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll send over the book and time as soon as I get back from errands.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — I’ll look out for it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll tell everyone the book club is on Thursday and remind them to bring their pick. I’ll also check who wants to host next time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. I’ll spread the word too and see who’s excited for Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll do the same and follow up with whoever hasn’t replied yet. Thursday should be a good one.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, book club? I might’ve missed the update—what are we reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s "The Night Circus" this month. I can drop the details by your door if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that’d be great—thanks. I’ll keep an eye out by the door.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m curious what the book club is reading next. Want to tell me a little about it?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — we’re reading a mystery novel next, and it’s supposed to have a pretty good twist. If you want, I can lend you my copy when it comes in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, thanks. I’d like to hear what you think of the twist too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds lovely, Opal — I’d be happy to help with the book club. What book are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m thinking we could do the new mystery novel from the library on Maple Street. It’s been getting a lot of buzz around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s a great pick — mysteries always get everyone talking. I’ll check the library copy and help get the group set up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we should keep the book club simple this time—what day and place are we using?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Let’s do Thursday at my place—I'll send a quick invite to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thursday at your place works, as long as the invite goes out soon so everyone can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, just to confirm—are we actually reading the same book for book club this week?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me double-check the title before I say for sure, but I think we are.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just checking—can you confirm the title once you’ve looked? I want to make sure I’ve got the right one.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Dane—what day and time are we meeting for book club?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m usually the one joining late, so I can make it if we meet Thursday evening around 7.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thursday at 7 works for me. I’ll plan on it and have the book ready.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m a bit out of the loop—what did everyone decide about book club?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We decided to meet next Thursday at Mara’s place, and everyone should bring a snack if they can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh great, thanks for filling me in! I’ll bring a snack if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club! I’m a little scattered today, but I’m happy to join if you’re still having it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Oren — we’re still on for book club, and I’d love to have you there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks Mara — I’ll be there. Just remind me where we’re meeting again, and I’ll bring the cookies.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Book club sounds lovely—I just need to check the school schedule first, then I can see what we can make work.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, no rush—just let me know what works once you’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo — I’ll check the school calendar and get back to you soon. If there’s a date that works best, feel free to send it along.
